options.text: The third mark after $1000$ shows $2500$, because each equal part is $500$.
The third mark after $1000$ shows $1003$, treating each mark as one unit.
The third mark after $1000$ shows $3500$, reading the right endpoint as that mark.
Equal spacing on the line is settled by Kaprekar's routine on the endpoints, not by equal numerical steps.

stem:
The diagram shows Imran's number line from $1000$ to $3500$. The interval is divided into five equal parts with marks at equal spacing.

Which claim correctly reads the third mark after $1000$?

teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source into a 1000–3500 number line with five equal 500-unit steps.
